tool_schemas.name: get_current_stock_price
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached quote/last-trade price for the requested Yahoo Finance symbol (fetching from the upstream source on a cache miss) and includes the symbol in the response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if symbol is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the symbol is unknown or no quote data is available, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Yahoo Finance cannot be reached or returns an unexpected response.

tool_schemas.name: get_stock_price_by_date
tool_schemas.description: Returns the price data for the requested symbol on the specified YYYY-MM-DD trading date (using cached historical data with read-through fetch on miss). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format or cannot be parsed, NOT_FOUND if there is no data for that symbol/date (including non-trading days), and UPSTREAM_ERROR if the upstream historical lookup fails.

tool_schemas.name: get_stock_price_date_range
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical prices for the requested symbol between start_date and end_date (inclusive when data exists), in chronological order, using read-through caching. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if dates are not valid YYYY-MM-DD strings or if start_date is after end_date, NOT_FOUND if the symbol has no data in the requested window, and UPSTREAM_ERROR on upstream or parsing failures. This endpoint returns the full range in a single response (no pagination).

tool_schemas.name: get_historical_stock_prices
tool_schemas.description: Returns historical price series for the requested symbol for the given period and interval, using cached Yahoo Finance chart data and refreshing on cache miss. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if period/interval are not one of the allowed enum values or symbol is empty, NOT_FOUND if no historical series exists for the symbol at the requested granularity, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Yahoo Finance rejects the request or returns malformed data. Results are returned as a complete series for the requested period (no pagination).

tool_schemas.name: get_dividends
tool_schemas.description: Returns the dividend events (dates and amounts) for the requested symbol from cached corporate actions, fetching upstream on cache miss. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if symbol is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the symbol has no dividend history or cannot be resolved, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if the upstream corporate-actions query fails. Results are returned as a complete list (no pagination).

tool_schemas.name: get_income_statement
tool_schemas.description: Returns the income statement for the requested symbol at the requested frequency (yearly, quarterly, or trainling) using cached fundamentals with read-through fetch on miss. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if freq is not one of the allowed enum values or symbol is empty, NOT_FOUND if no income statement data is available for that symbol/frequency, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if the upstream fundamentals request fails.

tool_schemas.name: get_cashflow
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cashflow statement for the requested symbol at the requested frequency (yearly, quarterly, or trainling) using cached fundamentals with read-through fetch on miss. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if freq is not one of the allowed enum values or symbol is empty, NOT_FOUND if no cashflow data is available for that symbol/frequency, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if the upstream fundamentals request fails.

tool_schemas.name: get_earning_dates
tool_schemas.description:
Get earning dates.

    Args:
        symbol (str): Stock symbol in Yahoo Finance format.
        limit (int): max amount of upcoming and recent earnings dates to return. Default value 12 should return next 4 quarters and last 8 quarters. Increase if more history is needed.

tool_schemas.name: get_news
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest news items associated with the requested symbol using cached Yahoo Finance news with read-through fetch on miss. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if symbol is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if no news feed is available for the symbol, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if the upstream news lookup fails. Results are returned as a complete list (no pagination).

tool_schemas.name: generate_market_dashboard
tool_schemas.description: Generates a market sentiment dashboard PNG for the provided comma-separated index symbols and returns the image as a base64-encoded PNG payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if indices is provided but cannot be parsed into one or more symbols, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if required market data cannot be retrieved to render the dashboard. The image is generated and returned in a single response (no pagination).

tool_schemas.name: generate_portfolio_report
tool_schemas.description: Generates a portfolio performance tracking report PNG for the provided comma-separated stock symbols and returns the image as a base64-encoded PNG payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if symbols is provided but cannot be parsed into one or more symbols, NOT_FOUND if none of the requested symbols can be resolved to market data, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if required historical/quote data cannot be retrieved to render the report. The image is generated and returned in a single response (no pagination).

tool_schemas.name: generate_stock_technical_analysis
tool_schemas.description: Generates an asynchronous technical analysis dashboard for the requested Yahoo Finance ticker symbol and returns a report job record that includes the job/status metadata and the generated base64-encoded PNG once complete. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if symbol is missing or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to generate reports, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if report generation limits are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND if the symbol is unknown/unavailable from Yahoo Finance, CONFLICT if a report job for the same symbol is already running, and STATE_ERROR if the job cannot be created or transitioned to a running/complete state.

tool_schemas.name: list_instruments
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached instruments with optional filtering and pagination. Returns a page of instrument records ordered by last_seen_at desc (then symbol asc). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid filters/pagination parameters.

query.description: Optional substring match against symbol or display_name (case-insensitive).

currency.description: Filter by ISO currency code (exact match).

tool_schemas.name: get_instrument
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single instrument by id. Returns the instrument record if found. Raises NOT_FOUND if no instrument exists for the provided id.

tool_schemas.name: update_instrument
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an instrument, including driving valid status transitions (active/inactive/delisted/blocked). Returns the updated instrument. Raises NOT_FOUND if id does not exist and VALIDATION_ERROR if an invalid status transition is requested or immutable fields are provided.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for the instrument's primary market.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must follow allowed transitions for the current status.

tool_schemas.name: list_render_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists dashboard/report generation jobs (events_and_reports rows with render_kind set) with optional filtering and pagination. Returns a page ordered by created_at desc. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid filters/pagination parameters.

instrument_id.description: Filter by instrument id (for instrument-scoped renders).

include_expired.description: When true, includes expired jobs in results; otherwise expired jobs may be omitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_render_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single render job by id. Returns the job metadata; includes result_base64 only when status=ready and expires_at is in the future. Raises NOT_FOUND if id does not exist and VALIDATION_ERROR if the job is expired and the caller requests content.

include_result.description: When true, includes result_mime_type/result_base64 if the job is ready and not expired; otherwise returns metadata only.

tool_schemas.name: refresh_symbol_cache
tool_schemas.description: Forces a refresh from the upstream Yahoo Finance source for one symbol and one data domain, upserting cached rows. Returns a summary of refreshed records and the instrument id. Refuses requests for blocked instruments and raises UPSTREAM_ERROR on upstream failures.

period.description: Required when domain=prices to define the upstream fetch window.

freq.description: Required when domain is fundamentals_income or fundamentals_cashflow.
